```{r}
#Upload packages
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(patchwork)
library(lubridate)
library(MBA)
library(mgcv)
library(FNN)
library(zoo)
library(reshape2)
library(rioja)
library(egg)
library(palr)
library(ggsci)

```

```{r}
# 2024 corrected buoy data
b22 <- read.csv(here("outputs", "buoy_corr_dm_2022.csv"))
b23 <- read.csv(here("outputs", "buoy_corr_dm_2023.csv"))
b24 <- read.csv(here("outputs", "buoy_corr_dm_2024.csv"))
b25 <- read.csv(here("outputs", "buoy_corr_dm_2025.csv"))

bsal <- read.csv(here("files", "buoy_ts_all.csv"))

wind <- read_csv(here("files", "wind_all.csv"))

weath <- read_csv(here("outputs", "enviro_weather_2025-04-14.csv"))

#Downloading discrete chlorophyll samples
cd <- read_csv(here("files", "2025-03-25_HakaiData_chlorophyll.csv"))

```
```{r}
#Reducing size and complexity of the chlorophyll data. none of this data is currently QC'd.
cd_0 <- cd %>% 
  filter(filter_type == "Bulk GF/F" & line_out_depth == 0 & site_id == "KC10") %>% 
  select(date, chla)

cd_all <- cd %>% 
  filter(filter_type == "Bulk GF/F" & site_id == "KC10") %>% 
  select(date, line_out_depth, chla)
```

```{r}
b22 <- b22 %>% 
  select(date_corr, fl_med_day) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(date = lubridate::ymd(date_corr)) %>% 
  select(date, fl_med_day)

b23 <- b23 %>% 
  select(date_corr, fl_med_day) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(date = lubridate::ymd(date_corr))

b24 <- b24 %>% 
  select(date_corr, fl_med_day) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(date = lubridate::ymd(date_corr))

b25 <- b25 %>% 
  select(date_corr, fl_med_day) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(date = lubridate::ymd(date_corr)) %>% 
  select(date, fl_med_day)
```

```{r}
dates24 <- as.data.frame(seq(as.Date("2024-01-01"),as.Date("2024-12-04"),1))

b24_cor1 <- b24 %>% 
  filter(date <= "2024-03-19" | date >= "2024-03-25")

b24_cor2 <- dates24 %>% 
  rename(date = `seq(as.Date("2024-01-01"), as.Date("2024-12-04"), 1)`) %>% 
  left_join(b24_cor1) %>% 
  select(date, fl_med_day)

b24_cor3 <- data.frame(date = seq(b24_cor2$date[1], b24_cor2$date[nrow(b24_cor2)], by = 1)) %>%
  full_join(b24_cor2, by = "date") %>%
  mutate(fl_fill = na.approx(fl_med_day)) %>% 
  select(date, fl_med_day = fl_fill) 

# 
dates23 <- as.data.frame(seq(as.Date("2023-01-01"),as.Date("2023-05-05"),1))

b23_cor1 <- b23 %>% 
  filter(date <= "2023-03-29" | date >= "2023-04-01")

b23_cor2 <- dates23 %>% 
  rename(date = `seq(as.Date("2023-01-01"), as.Date("2023-05-05"), 1)`) %>% 
  left_join(b23_cor1) %>% 
  select(date, fl_med_day)

b23_cor3 <- data.frame(date = seq(b23_cor2$date[1], b23_cor2$date[nrow(b23_cor2)], by = 1)) %>%
  full_join(b23_cor2, by = "date") %>%
  mutate(fl_fill = na.approx(fl_med_day)) %>% 
  select(date, fl_med_day = fl_fill) 


# %>% 
#   mutate(date = lubridate::ymd(date_corr),
#          year = lubridate::year(date),
#          yday = lubridate::yday(date))
  
```
```{r}
b_all <- rbind(b22, b23_cor3, b24_cor3, b25)

b_all <- b_all %>% 
  mutate(year = lubridate::year(date),
         yday = lubridate::yday(date))
```


```{r}
b_all <- b_all %>% 
  group_by(year) %>% 
  mutate(csum = cumsum(fl_med_day)) %>% 
  mutate(max = max(csum)) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

```{r}

csf_1 <- b_all %>% 
  mutate(date2 = as.Date(yday, origin = "2024-01-01"),
         month = month(date)) %>%
  filter(month < 6) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = date2, y = fl_med_day)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = as.factor(year)), size = 1.5) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "months", date_labels = "%b") +
  scale_color_simpsons()+
  scale_color_jama() +
  ylab(bquote("Flu"[BUOY]~"(mg" ~ m^-2*")")) +
  labs(color = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        text = element_text(size = 35), #35
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank())

csf_2 <- b_all %>% 
mutate(date2 = as.Date(yday, origin = "2024-01-01"),
         month = month(date)) %>%
  filter(month < 6) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = date2, y = csum)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = as.factor(year)), size = 2) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "months", date_labels = "%b") +
  scale_color_jama() +
  ylab(bquote("Int. Flu"[BUOY]~"(mg" ~ m^-2*")")) +
  labs(color = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.9, 0.18),
        text = element_text(size = 35), #35
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank())

csfig <- csf_1/csf_2 

ggsave(here("figures", "cum_sum_sb.png"), csfig,
        width = 16, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```
```{r}
test <- b_all %>% 
  left_join(weath)


b_all %>% 
  left_join(weath) %>% 
  mutate(date2 = as.Date(yday, origin = "2024-01-01"),
         month = month(date)) %>%
  filter(month < 6) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(x = date2, y = fl_med_day, color = as.factor(year)), size = 2) +
  geom_area(aes(x = date2, y = (w_dm^3)/10^2), alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "months", date_labels = "%b") +
  scale_color_simpsons()+
  scale_color_jama() +
  facet_grid(year~.) +
  ylab(bquote("Flu"[BUOY]~"(mg" ~ m^-2*")"~WS[LO]~"("*m^-3~s^-3*")")) +
  labs(color = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        text = element_text(size = 35), #35
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank())

ggsave(here("figures", "buoy_sb.png"), 
        width = 16, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
weath_cd <- weath %>% 
    left_join(cd_0) 

weath_cd %>% 
  mutate(month = month(date),
         year = year(date),
         yday = yday(date),
         date2 = as.Date(yday, origin = "2024-01-01")) %>% 
  filter(month < 6 & year >= 2018 & year <= 2020) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x = date2, y = chla),
             size = 2,
             stroke = 3,
             pch = 8,
             color = "forestgreen") +
  geom_area(aes(x = date2, y = (w_dm^3)/10^2), alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2019-05-11")) +
  ylim(0, 40) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "months", date_labels = "%b") +
  scale_color_simpsons()+
  scale_color_jama() +
  facet_grid(year~.) +
  ylab(bquote("Chl"~"(mg" ~ m^-2*")"~WS[LO]~"("*m^-3~s^-3*")")) +
  labs(color = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        text = element_text(size = 35), #35
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank())

ggsave(here("figures", "sb_2019.png"), 
        width = 16, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```
